title: ItemNotes
description: ItemNotes lets you attach private notes to specific items and helps distinguish similar items, especially server tools like teleportation sticks, etc..
body:
## About ItemNotes

**ItemNotes** is a client-side Minecraft mod that allows you to attach **private notes** to specific items and display them directly inside item tooltips.

![Here’s what it looks like:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43786c80fe72d9d71ea53cad61d60b73ef635213.png)

It helps you distinguish similar-looking items by using visible item data, stable identifiers when available, and local tracking history.

##  Useful for

* Custom tools
* Teleport sticks
* Kit items
* Named gear
* Shulker boxes
* Items with similar names or appearances
* Multiplayer servers with many custom items

##  Privacy

All notes are stored **locally on your client**.

They are **not sent to the server**, and other players cannot see them.
